Summary of all websites shared in #general:
• www.informations.com: A brief report says unemployment edged down to 7.2%, with the latest jobs report prompting both relief and concern.
• www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant is an alpine-inspired Swiss eatery offering cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue. Its website highlights rustic wooden interiors, Swiss memorabilia, panoramic city views, and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora! I visited www.dora-website.com. The content is straightforward, and including your email makes it easy for visitors to contact you. I think it would be more engaging with a short introduction about yourself and some details about your interests or projects. That would give visitors a better sense of who you are.

Hi Eve! I visited www.eve-blog.com. Mentioning your love of hiking gives the blog a clear personal touch. Based on the content available, I'd love to see more detail—such as stories from your hikes, favorite trails, or tips for beginners—to make it more engaging and useful for readers.
